Three reasons to intern at SAP 1. 2. Culture of collaboration: meet with mentors, make new friends across the globe and create a thriving personal network. What you'll do Position Title: SAP iXp Intern - Concur Travel, Software Developer Location: Vancouver, BC Expected Start Date: 4 May 2026 Contract Duration: 8 months Work Hours: Full-time/40 hours per week This team is responsible for managing Travel Policies and Approval processes. As a Software Developer Intern on the team, you will work on writing and delivering end-to-end features that bolster SAP Concur Travel's market leading position. Responsibilities: • Collaborating with Product Management, UX, and the rest of the team to design, develop, and deliver end-to-end solutions that simplify corporate travel management • Building expertise in a focused set of domains, while keeping an interest across services owned by the team • Extending our build/deploy pipeline automation • Adding performance enhancements to improve customer experience Investigating and remediating critical customer issues or vulnerabilities • Meet your team Our team, based in Vancouver, comprises a dynamic and diverse group of professionals across a wide range of career levels. Collaboration and engineering excellence are at the core of our team's values, as we actively engage with other Concur teams across the globe to deliver innovations to our market leading corporate travel product. Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. We win with inclusion SAP's culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone - regardless of background - feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
